inputs: Click View; collect the live accessible menu/row identities, labels, focus, enabled/sensitive states and unavailable reasons alongside the rendered menu.
Use Down/Up to visit Fit and Layer Visibility; record accessible focus/state after each key, then press Enter on the unavailable row.
Repeat row navigation/refusal for pointer-opened Help / About Datum and Window / Documents; press Escape and verify editor focus and F operability.
Change focused content Board to unresolved schematic and back through the existing pane controls; repeat View accessibility observations and confirm Fit availability changes with the rendered row.
Inspect that existing Terminal and Preferences accessibility objects are not replaced by menu objects; no setting change is made.

dispatches.unavailable_reason: Layer Visibility menu action is unavailable in this build.
About Datum is unavailable in this build.
Documents menu action is unavailable in this build.

actual_visible: I inspected all sixteen S05 PNGs, including the separate native Preferences window. Up/Down visibly moves the row outline. Fit is bright on Board and gray on unresolved Schematic; the three missing consumers remain gray, focusable for inspection and non-executing. Dismissal removes menus; Escape then F restores fitted viewing. Global Preferences opens as a separate input-modal window and its dismissal restores the working View menu. The main-window capture during that modal is black above the terminal strip; this is not a claim of full Preferences visual conformance.
actual_state: Live native AT-SPI nodes expose menu identity/label and matching focused/enabled/sensitive/reason states; owned-bus ChildrenChanged and menu StateChanged signals are recorded. Menus disappear from queried accessible children after dismissal while Terminal remains. Preferences and Terminal coexist in the live tree, and preferences_open is false after physical Escape. Production state, source and configuration comparisons establish the scoped no-write claim.
